title.ja: index-1 DAEの整合初期化と離散残差
title.en: Consistent initialization and discrete residuals for an index-one DAE

summary.ja: 既知の正枝を持つindex-1 DAEで初期化と後退Eulerの誤差・残差を分離します。
summary.en: Separate initialization, backward-Euler error and residuals on a known positive index-one DAE branch.

assumptions.ja: 無次元・正枝。微分行と代数行の尺度はそれぞれ1で、最大ノルムを用います。
assumptions.en: Dimensionless positive branch; differential and algebraic row scales are both one, with the maximum norm.

algorithm.ja: 連立Newtonと同じ尺度のArmijo線探索を用い、特異な初期推測は修復せず記録します。
algorithm.en: Use coupled Newton with an Armijo search in the same scaled norm, retaining rather than repairing a singular initial guess.

validation.ja: 独立Decimal製造解・3つの離散根と3固定格子を比較し、一次誤差と代数拘束を確認します。
validation.en: Compare independent Decimal manufactured states, three discrete roots and three fixed grids, checking first-order error and the algebraic constraint.

limits.ja: 単一の製造正枝・固定BE計算です。IDA実行や一般DAEソルバーの検証ではありません。
limits.en: One authored positive branch and fixed BE runs; no IDA execution or general DAE-solver qualification.

references.title: SUNDIALS v7.1.1 IDA mathematics, section 5.2
references.review_scope: Residual form, BDF/Newton and consistent initialization sections selected. Section5.2 is not an IDA version. This authored MMS/BE solver is not IDA.

caption.ja: 既知の正枝を持つindex-1 DAEで初期化と後退Eulerの誤差・残差を分離します。 保存配列から作図。
caption.en: Separate initialization, backward-Euler error and residuals on a known positive index-one DAE branch. Drawn from saved arrays.

caption.ja: 保存済み残差・拘束・収支を別表示。ゼロ値は対称対数軸で保持します。
caption.en: Saved residuals, constraints and budgets shown separately; symmetric log axes retain zero values.

title.ja: Robertson保存制約DAEと公式IDA保存値
title.en: Robertson conservation DAE and stored official IDA values

summary.ja: Robertsonの保存制約DAEと全ODEを同じ固定時間格子で比較し、公式IDA保存値を別に照合します。 初回は元の時間精度・細分化目標4件が未達でした。
summary.en: Compare the Robertson conservation DAE and full ODE on the same fixed time grids, with a separate check of stored official IDA values. The first retained run missed four original time-accuracy and refinement goals.

assumptions.ja: モデル時間0から4。中間種と残差の尺度は1e-4。公式印字値の丸め幅と数値誤差を区別します。
assumptions.en: Model time zero to four; the intermediate-species state and residual scale is 1e-4. Printing intervals and numerical errors are distinct.

algorithm.ja: 解析Jacobian付き固定BE/Newtonを使い、質量の投影・濃度クリップはしません。
algorithm.en: Use fixed BE/Newton with analytic Jacobians and no mass projection or concentration clipping.

validation.ja: 元39目標をすべて実測し、精度・細分化4目標の未達を変更せず研究結果として記録します。他35条件と独立参照・保存配列からの判定再計算は必須です。
validation.en: Evaluate all 39 original targets, retaining the four unmet accuracy/refinement goals as study outcomes. The other 35 requirements, independent references and faithful saved-array recomputation remain mandatory.

limits.ja: 公式SUNDIALS v7.1.1の2印字行のみ。IDAの新規実行0、長時間の化学精度や一般DAE性能は扱いません。 この固定時間格子の漸近収束や元精度目標の全合格は主張しません。
limits.en: Only two official SUNDIALS v7.1.1 printed rows; zero new IDA executions, with no long-time chemistry or general DAE-performance claim. No asymptotic-convergence or all-original-accuracy-goals claim is made for this fixed schedule.

references.title: SUNDIALS v7.1.1 idaRoberts_dns example
references.review_scope: Read residual/Jacobian, initialization, tolerances and print format. Own first two residual rows have opposite sign and the same zero set.

references.title: Stored official v7.1.1 IDA Robertson output
references.review_scope: Selected printed t=0.4 and4 values only, with Decimal rounding intervals. These approximate IDA values are not exact truth; no IDA run is performed here.

caption.ja: Robertsonの保存制約DAEと全ODEを同じ固定時間格子で比較し、公式IDA保存値を別に照合します。 保存配列から作図。 初回の元精度目標未達と再実行の実測判定は保存JSONで区別します。
caption.en: Compare the Robertson conservation DAE and full ODE on the same fixed time grids, with a separate check of stored official IDA values. Drawn from saved arrays. The first-run goal shortfall and each rerun’s actual target decisions remain explicit in the saved JSON.

caption.ja: 保存済み残差・拘束・収支を別表示。ゼロ値は対称対数軸で保持します。 初回の元精度目標未達と再実行の実測判定は保存JSONで区別します。
caption.en: Saved residuals, constraints and budgets shown separately; symmetric log axes retain zero values. The first-run goal shortfall and each rerun’s actual target decisions remain explicit in the saved JSON.

title.ja: 振り子の指数低減・拘束ドリフト・明示安定化
title.en: Index reduction, constraint drift and explicit stabilization for a pendulum

summary.ja: 位置拘束の指数3系から明示ODEを導き、整合・非整合初期値の拘束ドリフトと安定化を比較します。
summary.en: Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts.

assumptions.ja: m=L=g=1、初期角0.7、初期角速度0。非整合制御では半径方向速度を明示的に加えます。
assumptions.en: m=L=g=1, initial angle 0.7 and zero angular velocity; off-manifold controls explicitly add radial velocity.

algorithm.ja: 指数低減ODEと臨界拘束誤差拡張を固定RK4で積分し、拘束仕事も同じ段で積分します。
algorithm.en: Advance the index-reduced ODE and a critical constraint-error extension with fixed RK4, integrating constraint work at the same stages.

validation.ja: Jacobi解析族と独立角度ODE2計算を資格確認し、場・拘束の厳密法則・エネルギー仕事収支を比較します。
validation.en: Qualify the Jacobi family against two independent angular ODE runs, then compare states, exact constraint laws and energy/work budgets.

limits.ja: 投影・正規化・SHAKE/RATTLEなし。一般指数3ソルバーやシンプレクティック性の検証ではありません。
limits.en: No projection, normalization or SHAKE/RATTLE; no general index-three-solver or symplecticity claim.

references.title: NIST DLMF section22.19(i), pendulum
references.review_scope: Selected pendulum formulas, phase and modulus convention. Authored Cartesian conversion uses K-t; SciPy takes parameter m=k². No full chapter reading claimed.

references.title: NIST DLMF section19.8(i), arithmetic-geometric mean
references.review_scope: Selected AGM/K identity; independent Decimal Machin pi and sine with explicit finite remainders qualify a single fixed modulus.

caption.ja: 位置拘束の指数3系から明示ODEを導き、整合・非整合初期値の拘束ドリフトと安定化を比較します。 保存配列から作図。
caption.en: Derive an explicit ODE from an index-three position constraint and compare drift and stabilization for consistent and inconsistent starts. Drawn from saved arrays.

caption.ja: 保存済み残差・拘束・収支を別表示。ゼロ値は対称対数軸で保持します。
caption.en: Saved residuals, constraints and budgets shown separately; symmetric log axes retain zero values.
